captions.detailed: This 3D model features a detached round stone belfry tower with a cylindrical shaft, decorated with subtle horizontal banding. The top tier of the tower has several open, decorative arched windows that reveal a dark wooden beam yoke inside. Hanging from this yoke is a cast-bronze bell, which is designed to swing on a horizontal revolute joint, while a clapper rod is suspended inside the bell on a secondary revolute pin.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a detached round stone belfry tower. The tower should feature a cylindrical shaft with decorative horizontal bands, arched windows in its upper tier, and an inner wooden yoke supporting a bronze bell and its clapper, both articulated with revolute joints.
captions.factory: The code constructs a cylindrical tower using a hollowed cylinder and subtracts arched windows created by boolean-cutting extruded profiles. Horizontal decorative bands are added as thin, wide cylinders. The wooden yoke, bronze bell, and clapper rod are modeled as separate parts using boxes, cylinders, and spheres, and are assembled with revolute joints to allow realistic articulation.
